items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: I bought that bass from O'Hara.

ctx.x: Did you get rid of your bass then? The string bass? Yeah, you kept it. You're wise to do that. I never did.
I'll tell you what I did do when I bought this bass I have here. I bought that bass from O'Hara. I got rid of the bass on that I had. That was in the bass. I traded it for the string bass.
